evidence.reason: The finding is already addressed at the pinned tip. `ClusterIdInput` now only converts safe integers in the range 10_000_000–99_999_999 and returns `String(value)` without padding; shorter numeric IDs fall through and fail the 8-hex-digit regex instead of being padded into another cluster ID. The history also includes commit 968e761f20e97734f51ab1fd140b0c4ea200405e explicitly titled to refuse short numeric cluster ids.
